item.title: Huntington Bancshares to report Q3 2026 earning...
item.description: Huntington Bancshares Incorporated will release its third quarter 2026 financial results on October 22, 2026, before the market opens. The company will provide a news release and financial data on its Investor Relations website and hold a conference call at 9 a.m. ET to discuss the results. Investors can access the call via webcast or phone, with replays available afterward. Huntington is a major regional bank with $284 billion in assets, serving consumers and businesses across 21 states.

item.title: XRP bullish calls surge as Open Interest hits r...
item.description: XRP price is holding just above the $1.50 resistance level, supported by a strong bullish trend driven by increased leveraged trading on major exchanges like Binance and Coinbase. Open Interest (OI) on Binance has surged 32% recently, reaching its highest growth since August 2025, signaling heightened market participation. Despite a negative Cumulative Volume Delta, past patterns suggest this setup often precedes bullish price moves. However, futures market liquidations indicate ongoing volatility, with more bulls being liquidated than shorts, reflecting both optimism and risk among investors. The market is closely watching if XRP can break above $1.50 towards $1.80 resistance next.

item.title: Dover to showcase new tech for convenience stor...
item.description: Dover announced that its operating companies will present innovative technologies and solutions at the National Association of Convenience Stores Trade Show and Petroleum Equipment Institute Convention in Las Vegas from October 6-9, 2026. The showcased products focus on enhancing efficiency and customer experience in convenience retail, covering areas like refrigeration, fueling, digital software, and vehicle wash. Highlights include energy-saving refrigeration doors, advanced fueling solutions, real-time site monitoring, and integrated car wash systems. This event positions Dover to expand its presence in the growing convenience retail market by offering sustainable and tech-forward solutions.
